requirements.name: Led a support team of at least five people for two or more years
spans: has led a support team of at least five people for two or more years

requirements.name: Writes clearly in English and Spanish
spans: writes clearly in English and Spanish because a growing share of our customers prefer Spanish
requirements.why: Native English, Spanish B2 written and spoken, writes Spanish replies.

requirements.name: Zendesk or a comparable helpdesk tool, well enough to build views and macros
spans: knows Zendesk or a comparable helpdesk tool well enough to build views and macros without help
requirements.why: Configures Zendesk views, triggers and macros herself.

requirements.name: Workforce scheduling and QA scorecards
spans: Experience with workforce scheduling and QA scorecards is important to us, since you will own both for your group.
requirements.why: 'is important to us' is read as required because the posting says you will own both; a reader may file it as preferred. Both are in the CV.

requirements.name: Legally authorised to work in Ireland
spans: Applicants must be legally authorised to work in Ireland; we are not able to sponsor work permits for this role.
requirements.why: Rule 3 exception: a condition the candidate must meet, stated as must. Irish citizen. Contested because it sits in the legal paragraph and a reader may treat it as boilerplate.

requirements.name: A background in telecommunications
spans: A background in telecommunications would help but is not essential;

notRequirements.span: Day to day you will coach agents through call reviews, run the weekly quality calibration, own the schedule for your group, and be the escalation point for the hardest customer cases.
You report to the Head of Support and meet the other team leads daily.

Salary from €48,000 to €56,000 depending on experience, a 10% annual bonus tied to customer satisfaction, 25 days of leave rising to 30, a health plan for you and your family, a pension matched up to 6%, a free Orbit mobile and broadband plan, and a learning allowance of €1,500 a year.
We work three days in the office and two from home, and we close the office between Christmas and New Year.
A 30-minute call with a recruiter, a conversation with the Head of Support, and a half-day with the team where you will review two recorded calls with us.
Orbit Telecom is an equal opportunity employer.
Straight talk. Customers hear the truth from us, even when it costs a sale.
Team leads run groups of eight to twelve agents and are the people our agents learn the job from.
most of our best leads came from retail, hospitality or utilities.
